explain.title: The outer structure
explain.body: Every HTML page has a basic structure. The line <!DOCTYPE html> tells the browser that this is an HTML5 document. The <html> element is the root element that contains the page.

explain.title: Information and visible content
explain.body: The <head> section contains meta-information about the HTML document, like the title. The <title> sets the title of the web page, which appears in the browser tab. The <body> contains the content that you see in the browser.
